children: Airbnb (ABNB, Financials), is expanding its services business through a new partnership with Instacart (CART) that lets guests order groceries ahead of their stays.

Guests can place grocery orders through Airbnb up to three weeks before checking in, with free delivery on orders above $10. The service does not require a separate Instacart account or app, and Instacart will handle fulfillment.
Airbnb said groceries are among its most requested services. In select U.S. cities, hosts can also opt to receive orders and stock refrigerators and pantries before guests arrive.

The partnership gives Airbnb another way to add convenience around its core lodging business while creating a potential avenue for Instacart to reach travelers. The service is initially available in the U.S. and is expected to expand to Canada by the end of 2026.
TipRanks data shows 34 Wall Street analysts have an average ABNB price target of $187.23, implying about 16% upside from current levels. The consensus includes 21 Buy, 12 Hold and one Sell rating.
The next catalyst is whether Airbnb expands grocery delivery and other stay-related services across more markets and converts them into a meaningful part of its broader platform.

title: Airbnb Adds a New Service to the Stay
